jitter.title: Jitter Analysis
jitter.description: Jitter measures pitch variation and is often elevated in Parkinson's disease due to vocal fold rigidity and reduced motor control.

shimmer.title: Shimmer Analysis
shimmer.description: Shimmer indicates amplitude variation, which can reflect breath control issues and vocal muscle coordination problems common in neurological conditions.

hnr.title: Harmonic-to-Noise Ratio
hnr.description: Lower HNR values suggest breathiness or roughness in voice, often associated with reduced vocal cord function in Parkinson's patients.
